purpose: Teach: 地方裁判所/光学/良識/米価/併合/異質/筆記/伝授

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療過誤の地方裁判所判例を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Ren, we're studying medical malpractice case law from district courts as a team.
lines.style: Measured, professional opening. Clear enunciation. The tone of someone teaching without lecturing. Steady eye contact, shoulders back.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、光学機器を用いた診断を医療チームで活用します
lines.en: Yes, we're incorporating optical diagnostic equipment into our clinical practice.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Warm but clinical. Patient pace—not rushed, giving space for the information to land. Slight emphasis on 'optical' as a meaningful detail.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の良識に訴える治療同意を医療チームで重視します
lines.en: Ren, we place a high priority on treatment consent that respects the patient's own judgment.
lines.style: Deliberate, careful. This matters—the slight weight on 'judgment' shows conviction without heat. Calm throughline. Speaking as though Ren will understand why this distinction is important.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 米価高騰時の病院食改善を、貴院、進められてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital is really making progress on improving patient meals during these high rice prices, isn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with underlying respect. Soft opening—he's noticed something real and wants to acknowledge it. A little tentative, like he's checking if the observation is welcome. Warm, not formal.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、病院併合の医療連携を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, I'm overseeing the medical coordination across our merged hospital divisions.
lines.style: Factual, professional. Steady rhythm. No flourish—just clear ownership of the work. The voice of someone comfortable with responsibility but not boasting about it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 異質な症例を、貴院、学会発表されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital presents some really interesting rare cases at conferences, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Gentle admiration. Open, interested tone—he's drawn to the intellectual rigor. Not flattering, but genuine. Slight lift at the end, like he's inviting her to talk about something she cares about.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の筆記式問診を医療チームで活用します
lines.en: Yes, we're actively using written patient assessments as part of our clinical approach.
lines.style: Steady, informative. The tone of explaining something methodical and deliberate. Patient, not rushed. A slight warmth underneath—she's explaining something she believes in.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療技術の伝授を医療チームで継承します
lines.en: Yes, we make sure to pass down medical knowledge and skills to the next generation of our team.
lines.style: Warm but measured. Gentle closing—the voice of someone who sees continuity and legacy as part of the work. Slight softening at the end, a breath of care underneath the professionalism. Almost intimate, but still clear.
